description: This file defines the `LogView` class, a custom Android widget extending `TextView`, used for displaying log messages. It implements the `LogNode` interface to format and output log data received through its `println` method, supporting chaining of log nodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom widget extending TextView to display log messages, implementing the LogNode interface for log output and chaining.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log data with priority, tag, message, and exception details, and appends the output to the LogView. Ensures UI thread update and forwards logs to the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView.
